release.note: Checked 2026-11-26 by fresh installs from the npm registry. 0.4.2 changes only init (it installs @tapedb/cli); the engine is 0.4.1's. 0.4.0 is deprecated: it was packed from a stale build.

statusMeaning.released: In @tapedb/tapedb 0.4.2 on npm, documented in API.md.
statusMeaning.documentation: A measured fact or a decision record, not an API.

entries.name: Typed models and serializable transactions in one workspace
guarantees: One SQLite Durable Object per workspace; writes are serializable without locks.
A transaction is one log entry; a retried clientTxId is answered from its receipt.
limits: A transaction or join stays in one workspace; no cross-workspace atomic writes and no active-active.
One writer per workspace: past about 4 concurrent writers, latency rises instead of throughput (local benchmark, BENCHMARKS.md).

entries.name: Role and row-level read and write rules
guarantees: role(), filter() and check() rules per action; filter() compiles into SQL.
limits: check() runs after fetch and is scan-capped (LIMITATIONS.md).

entries.name: Live queries with diffs over one socket per workspace
guarantees: Identical subscriptions share one re-run per flush.
Diffs carry order when rows move.
limits: Each write re-runs the live queries on the models it touches, before the next request is served (about 18 ms per write at 100 live queries, engine benchmark).
200 subscribers saw each write within 62 ms p50 and 112 ms p99 locally.

entries.name: Presence rooms and broadcast topics
guarantees: Ephemeral; topic replay for listeners that reconnect within realtime.replaySeconds (default 60).
limits: At most realtime.maxPresenceRooms rooms per socket (default 4).
Presence fan-out grows with the square of the room: every update sends the full peer list to every peer (60 ms p50 at 200 peers against 15 ms for a broadcast, local; BENCHMARKS.md).
Socket JSON messages bounded to 4 MiB; topic replay bounded to 8 MiB per workspace.

entries.name: Optimistic, offline-capable client writes
guarantees: Queued writes carry a clientTxId; the engine dedupes retries from permanent receipts.
limits: Durable only if the outbox store is (MemoryOutbox is not).

entries.name: R2 files with an indexed file table and file rules
guarantees: Multipart uploads; file rules decide reads and writes per file.

entries.name: R2 log segments, snapshots and recovery
guarantees: A wiped Durable Object recovers from R2 in budgeted steps and answers 503 workspace_recovering meanwhile.
Staging drill: 31,108 rows recovered after deleting every object of the class.
limits: R2 trails commits by up to the 30 s durability alarm delay plus the flush; recovery after losing the object's storage starts from R2.

entries.name: Signed change webhooks from a transactional outbox
guarantees: Captured inside the write's transaction; delivered after the log reaches R2.
At-least-once, signed, stable event id, ordered per endpoint.
limits: First retry 30 s, doubling to at most 30 min; dead-lettered after 24 h or 60 attempts (src/engine/webhooks.ts in 0.4.1).
A failing head event holds back its endpoint's later events.
Not a general job queue; no exactly-once delivery.

entries.name: Inspect stuck webhooks and retry them
guarantees: GET /webhooks, GET /webhooks/deliveries, POST /webhooks/retry; a retry re-queues the original event (same id, sequence and signed body).
limits: Staging green; the webhooks e2e scenario only runs locally (a deployed Worker cannot reach its receiver).

entries.name: Named read-only SQL queries declared in the schema
guarantees: Values always bound; engine tables, sqlite_schema and personal fields refused; role and read rules checked.
limits: One-off read of one workspace; not live; not a warehouse.

entries.name: count, sum, avg, min, max and groupBy
limits: Refused on personal fields.

entries.name: Vectorize-backed vector, text and hybrid search on one model
guarantees: Index intents committed with the write; reranker optional.
limits: One indexed model per deployment; Vectorize visibility lags acceptance; no live search subscriptions; one provider.

entries.name: $across: reads merged on the client from several workspaces
guarantees: Each workspace is asked with its own claim; a failed workspace yields AcrossError with the other rows in partial.
limits: Measured on Cloudflare (ADR 0001): about 0.23-0.33 s at 100 workspaces and 3.9 s at 1,000 with concurrency 64.
Beyond about 100 workspaces for interactive use, use a read model.

entries.name: $across concurrency bound (default 64) and later-getToken fix
Opt-in writer audit, per-row history, personal-field erasure, retention
guarantees: Deleted values leave every TapeDB copy within the retention (default 30 days).
Erasing a subject key makes its ciphertext unreadable everywhere.
limits: Cloudflare's own 30-day Durable Object point-in-time recovery is outside TapeDB's control (PRIVACY.md).

entries.name: Better Auth adapter, AuthRoom, workspace membership and roles
guarantees: Each adapter operation is atomic; consumeOne and incrementOne are single statements in one AuthRoom.
limits: No multi-call transactions (transaction: false).
All auth tables in one AuthRoom: one writer for every sign-in.
LIMITATIONS.md in 0.4.2 still says TapeDB 'does not manage users, sessions, passwords or memberships', which built-in auth contradicts. Reported to the TapeDB owner.

entries.name: Better Auth plugin compatibility matrix
guarantees: Verified in workerd: session revocation, ban, magic link, TOTP, backup codes, organizations, JWT/JWKS, OAuth 2.1 provider (registration, PKCE, refresh rotation with reuse detection, revocation), device authorization; single-use steps succeed once under concurrent requests.
limits: Flows in runWithTransaction can leave partial writes (organization member changes, OAuth client registration, passkey registration with a session).
Passkeys partly verified; account linking not verified; SAML/LDAP out of scope.

entries.name: GET /metrics with a health verdict
guarantees: Counters and bucket histograms in memory; gauges from SQLite; health ok/degraded/failing with reason codes.
limits: Counters reset with the object; the flush counter is recorded after the gauge moves within one pass.

entries.name: GET /queries: costliest read statements with SQLite plans
guarantees: rowsRead from the Durable Object cursor; full scans and index candidates named; no values recorded.
limits: Wall time reads 0 ms on Cloudflare for synchronous SQL.

entries.name: Per-model and per-workspace write budgets

notProvided.use: A separate data plane (R2 plus a query engine)
Design tenancy so a transaction stays in one workspace

findings.text: POST /v1/transact applies wire ops as given: schema defaults are filled by the typed client, so an insert that omits a defaulted field is refused with invalid_op ("requires attribute"). API.md does not say so.

Projects made by init before 0.4.2 have no tapedb-cli bin, so the printed `npx tapedb-cli ...` runs the deprecated unscoped tapedb-cli@0.1.30 from the registry. Fixed in 0.4.2: a fresh `npx @tapedb/cli@0.4.2 init` pins @tapedb/cli 0.4.2 and `npx tapedb-cli` runs it (checked against the registry 2026-11-26). Older projects: npm install -D @tapedb/cli@<their tapedb version>.
